div.div: Burn rate: how fast failures use up the SLO's error budget. OTLP: the OpenTelemetry wire protocol. Span metrics: request rate, errors and latency counted from traces. DCGM: NVIDIA Data Center GPU Manager. KEDA: Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling. NAT: network address translation. vLLM: the open-source model server from P1. L4: the NVIDIA GPU it runs on.
